password-input.$description: v0.7 — Password entry with reveal toggle in the trailing slot. Reuses input.* shell tokens. This file owns only the reveal-button surface (a small interactive child inside the trailing slot).

reveal.$description: The 'Show' / 'Hide' toggle in the trailing slot. Renders as a real <button data-interactive>; gets its own scoped focus indicator inside the field shell.

type.$description: Uppercase mono label — matches the system-metadata signature.

value.$description: Password renders mono so the masking dots are tabular-aligned and visually steady on typing.

letter-spacing.$description: Wider tracking on the masked dots so each character reads as discrete.
